stance_roll_support.note: Knee and ankle already reach about ±1.91 N·m in a normal step, and hip pitch is on that rail once pitch is past about -8 deg. Hip roll is the lateral joint and was still near 1 N·m or below. Negative 0.08 rad on the loaded hip kept slalom seeds 271181 and 271339 upright. Positive 0.08 rad made 271339 fall.

note: Straight walks do not set a heading schedule, so the roll support does not run. cfg_f restart and cfg_d turns stay on their own hashes.
